classification_definitions.historical_audit_immutable: A historical review, receipt, attempt, capsule, log, status snapshot, or hash-bound artifact. It may be archived for audit but must retain original bytes and must never become executable authorization.
classification_definitions.migration_metadata: A migration document or manifest that names the old root only to describe the replacement boundary.
classification_definitions.public_code_blocker: An absolute source-machine path in executable public code, a current public config, or an operational command that must work after relocation. This blocks readiness until parameterized or regenerated.
classification_definitions.restricted_runtime_config: A machine-local restricted plan/config/result. Do not copy it as authority. Regenerate it on the new machine from public code and newly issued authorization; direct string replacement is unsafe unless an entry explicitly permits it.

historical_audit_immutable.note: Keep original bytes. If needed on the new machine, place reviewed copies below data/migration/audit_archive/r22 and make them read-only.

public_code_blocker.note: No source-root literal was found in executable src/, scripts/, tools/, tests/, or pyproject surfaces before adding this migration package.

restricted_runtime_config.note: Regenerate after new-machine path selection and renewed authorization. Do not in-place rewrite old receipts.

replacement_contract.documentation: Use $AV_TRACE_ROOT in operator commands, not a copied machine path.
replacement_contract.historical_records: Do not rewrite signed, hash-bound, receipt, attempt, failure, audit, or provenance records. Preserve their original path strings as historical evidence.
replacement_contract.restricted_storage: Keep restricted storage below $AV_TRACE_ROOT/data/restricted unless a separately reviewed runtime config points to a secure external volume.
replacement_contract.runtime: Resolve the repository from --repo-root, AV_TRACE_ROOT, or the script location; keep stored paths repository-relative.

rules.reason: These files describe the old-to-new path boundary.
Executable code and current test/config surfaces must derive the root dynamically.
These records can encode cwd, local model paths, route state, or authorization-dependent execution state.
Generated results, orchestration prompts/transcripts, raw attempts, and child argv provenance preserve the source execution environment and are excluded from restored runtime state.
This test validates a frozen historical status snapshot whose recorded source path must remain unchanged.
The old path is part of the recorded environment or quoted evidence.
Receipts, logs, attempts, authorization records, and failure capsules are immutable audit material, not restart state.
R22 capsules and markers may be copied only into the read-only audit archive and may not authorize execution.

steps: Scan text files for the exact source_root literal.
Classify every match using the ordered rules above.
Block on public_code_blocker or unclassified matches.
For restricted_runtime_config, regenerate from public code with --repo-root/AV_TRACE_ROOT and fresh authorization; do not carry old authorization state.
For historical_audit_immutable, copy only when needed for audit, verify the source hash, retain original bytes, and remove owner write permission in the destination archive.
Re-run the scan and readiness verifier after regeneration.
